title: ci: post merged master PRs through the news pipeline
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Added `master` to the `pull_request_target` branches in `news-create-pr-gist.yml`, so merged PRs for the legacy text and image APIs can enter the same news-gist and Discord-post workflow as PRs into `main`. The trigger lives on `main` because `pull_request_target` uses the default branch’s workflow file regardless of a PR’s base branch. The scripts look up PRs by number, and manual runs succeeded for five `master` PRs.

The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, never oversized, and strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
